summary: Five churches in one family of parishes. The page 1 worship-site, Confession and Adoration boxes are identical in all five bulletins read and the weekly intentions agree, so every slot is settled. First Saturday Masses and First Friday Adoration and Confession are weekly with weeks_of_month first. The Nov 2 Evening of Remembrance is a prayer service, not a Mass, and is excluded. No open questions.
